projects.title: Samarkand Heritage
projects.shortDescription: Luxury hotel branding rooted in Silk Road heritage
projects.description: A complete brand identity for a luxury boutique hotel in Samarkand, marrying contemporary minimalism with the rich visual language of Uzbekistan's Timurid architectural heritage. The identity system spans from architecture signage to digital touchpoints.
projects.results: Brand launched to international acclaim, featured in Condé Nast Traveller

projects.title: UzPay
projects.shortDescription: Fintech super-app redefining digital payments in Central Asia
projects.description: End-to-end UX/UI design for a fintech platform serving 2M+ users across Uzbekistan. The design system prioritises clarity, trust, and accessibility — bringing modern financial services to users of all digital literacy levels.
projects.results: User satisfaction increased 40%, app store rating from 3.2 to 4.7

projects.title: Palov House
projects.shortDescription: Contemporary identity for an iconic Uzbek cuisine brand
projects.description: Brand identity for Tashkent's most celebrated plov restaurant. We distilled centuries of culinary tradition into a bold, contemporary visual language that honours authenticity while appealing to a modern cosmopolitan audience.
projects.results: Expanded to 4 locations, 300% increase in social media following

projects.title: Hilol
projects.description: Strategic rebrand for Uzbekistan's largest retail network. The project encompassed brand strategy, visual identity, store experience design, and a comprehensive rollout across 120+ locations nationwide.
projects.results: 30% increase in brand recognition, 120 stores rebranded in 8 months

projects.title: TechUZ
projects.shortDescription: Platform connecting Central Asian startups with global investors
projects.description: Full product design for a startup accelerator platform. From pitch deck management to investor discovery and deal flow — a complex product made simple through rigorous UX thinking.
projects.results: Platform used by 200+ startups, $12M in facilitated investments

projects.title: ANOR
projects.shortDescription: Luxury packaging for Uzbekistan's finest pomegranate wine
projects.description: Packaging design for a premium pomegranate wine brand. The label system merges botanical illustration with geometric patterns inspired by Uzbek tilework, resulting in a collectible series that commands premium shelf presence.
projects.results: Awarded Bronze at Pentawards 2023, listed in 8 countries
